title: Variant interop ledger: scheduled maintenance and automated parity checks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Reconcile and maintain a single source-of-truth compatibility ledger for fallback model variants (tokenizer, context window, and tooling surface parity) that drives smart-routing decisions (region selection, tier routing, and model fallbacks). Current gap: ad-hoc variant updates cause routing mismatches and sporadic customer regressions in multi-region failovers. This ticket scopes the maintenance runbook, automated parity checks, and a lightweight CI job to prevent regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility ledger (CSV + canonical JSON view) updated and validated against model catalog for all active fallback pairs
Automated CI parity job added to infra repo that verifies tokenizer and context window agreement for staged variants (runs on PR and nightly)
Routing decision layer reads ledger and rejects fallbacks marked incompatible during canary or production routing decisions
Runbook published in Confluence with step-by-step remediation and emergency rollback instructions
No customer-facing fallback regression observed in staging for two full days after rollout
tasks: Inventory current fallback mappings and last-verified timestamps
Write compatibility probe: tokenization equivalence tests (round-trip token counts, special tokens, BOS/EOS handling)
Add context-window validation: effective max sequence length and padding semantics
Verify tooling parity (tooling=structured output helpers, function-calling signatures) via example prompts
Implement CI job (infra/ci/parity-check) + nightly cron to re-run probes
Update routing service to consult ledger and surface compatibility reasons in decision logs
Create Confluence runbook and link dashboards for parity failures
comments: 2025-03-05 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff notes: Found 3 live routes where fallback to 'variant-lite-v2' caused tokenization truncation for long prompts. Goal is to prevent those mismatches by making ledger authoritative source for routing policies.

2025-03-08 - Eva Morales (PM): Prioritize this ahead of dedicated-region rollout next week. If ledger not ready, we risk region failovers picking incompatible variants.

2025-03-09 - Marco Chen: Pushed experimental CI job to github.com/redwood-inference/infra PR#478 — it runs tokenization and context-window checks. TODO: add tooling parity tests and auth for private models.

2025-03-11 - Security review (note): Tokenizer tests operate on model artifacts but do not export model weights. Confirmed with Security that this is allowed; KMS access not required for parity probes.
2025-03-12 - Aisha Patel: Updated acceptance criteria to add 48h staging observation window. Scheduling rollout for 2025-03-18 canary in us-west-2 only.
2025-03-12 - Marco Chen: Blocker discovered: some archived variants lack a published tokenizer version field in model-catalog — opened ENG-24114 to backfill metadata.

2025-03-12 - Design feedback (Liam Ross): Request adding a concise color-coded compatibility badge in Console variant details so SREs can quickly assess fallback safety during incidents. Added to follow-up list.
